gold_evidence_coverage.note: CRITICAL VALIDITY CONSTRAINT. This is the fullwiki split: the per-example context is RETRIEVED paragraphs, so the gold supporting-fact paragraphs are not guaranteed to be present. Evidence/support recall against gold pages is therefore structurally bounded, and bridge required-chain connectivity can only be measured where the full gold chain is present.
gold_evidence_coverage.implication: Headline answer EM/F1 use the full distribution. Supporting-fact precision/recall, joint score, citation recall, and bridge connectivity are PROXY metrics here and are reported on the full-coverage subset (clearly labelled) to avoid conflating retrieval miss with reasoning failure. The distractor split (gold paragraphs guaranteed present) is recommended for the final evidence-grounded matrix and is downloadable (network now available) but was not re-cached in this milestone.
